system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Before every query, it retrieves relevant long-term memories and injects them as structured XML into the system prompt.
system_prompt_style.note: README only; context from OS, scrollback, git, project, memory, custom instructions (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md).

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: nsh builds context from your OS, shell, working directory, recent terminal output, project structure, git state, and conversation history
env_context_strategy.note: Injected project/git context plus navigation tools (read_file, grep_file, glob, list_directory).

context_compaction.note: Only a per-output char cap is documented in README; code (e.g. src/memory/ingestion/output_truncator.rs) not opened. Other compaction may exist.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Read file contents with line numbers
observation_format.note: No image tools listed; tool output conversion code not opened.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: It responds by calling tools: `command` to prefill a shell command, `chat` for text answers
tool_call_format.note: Parser code not in evidence; inferred from tool-calling description with OpenAI-compatible APIs.

tool_count.evidence_quote: | `retrieve_secret` | Retrieve encrypted secrets from the knowledge vault |
tool_count.note: Count of README built-in tools table (26); registry src/tools/runtime/registry.rs not opened. Skills and MCP tools excluded.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: | `patch_file` | Surgical find-and-replace in files (with diff preview) |

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: nsh can connect to external MCP servers to gain new tools.
tool_schema_source.note: Skills declare parameters by hand in TOML; built-in schema source not seen.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: nsh works with MCP (Model Context Protocol) in both directions.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: It can chain multiple tool calls in a single turn, investigating before acting.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: It investigates before acting - searching history, reading files, running safe commands
planning_granularity.note: No plan tool in README tool table.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The `code` tool delegates programming tasks to a working-directory-constrained sub-agent that uses a more capable model.
multi_agent_topology.note: code tool is in default tool list.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Launch a working-directory-constrained coding sub-agent for multi-step file editing

human_in_loop.note: Default prefill: user reviews command before running; confirm_intermediate_steps optional.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: nsh reset` | Clear session conversation context

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: nsh has a 6-tier memory system inspired by the MIRIX architecture.
long_term_memory.note: SQLite memory tiers; skills in ~/.nsh/skills; project instruction files. No vector store mentioned (FTS search).

state_persistence.note: Conversation stored in SQLite but no resume path visible; code not opened.

self_verification.note: README says agent 'executes and verifies results' but no harness-enforced check shown.

retry_policy.note: Model fallback on rate limits is transport retry, not task retry.

rollback.evidence_quote: Create or overwrite files (with diff preview and trash backup)
rollback.note: Trash backup, no undo tool evident.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: | `done` | End the tool loop with a structured summary |
termination_condition.note: Also: 'nsh can chain multiple tool calls per query (50 by default, configurable)' -> max_steps. Other conditions not visible in excerpts.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Anthropic** - Claude models with prompt caching
cost_controls.note: fast/main/coding model tiers; cost tracking only reports.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: nsh wraps your shell in a PTY, capturing scrollback and command history into a local SQLite database.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: reads and writes to `~/.ssh`, `~/.gnupg`, `~/.aws`, `~/.kube`, `~/.docker`, and similar directories are blocked by default.
filesystem_access.note: Host filesystem with sensitive-dir blocklist; coding sub-agent constrained to working directory.

network_policy.note: No network config surface in README; code not opened.

permission_model.evidence_quote: every suggested command is classified as `safe`, `elevated`, or `dangerous`.
permission_model.note: Plus run_command allowlist and per-command prefill review.

tracing.evidence_quote: all tool calls are logged to `~/.nsh/audit.log` with automatic rotation.
tracing.note: audit.log is JSON-line; JSON event stream output also.

eval_hooks.note: File tree shows no eval dir, but source not grepped.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Prompt injection attempts in tool output are filtered.
guardrails.note: Secret redaction; dangerous-command confirmation; sensitive dir blocking.

target_domain.evidence_quote: AI-powered shell assistant for `zsh`, `bash`, `fish`, and PowerShell.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: nsh works with any OpenAI-compatible API.
